  WHY: Harness script defects are routed to the consumer fix-up as project-owned. Severity disagreement: NIT/low confidence 2 (anthropic) vs MAJOR (gemini, openai); highest used.

  WHY: A wrong or empty consumer_root makes every path look absent from the consumer, silently moving project files to harness ownership. Severity disagreement: NIT (anthropic, minimax hardening) vs MAJOR (gemini); highest used.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:1625-1627 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: VALIDATION_REASON_STAGES ties each reason to exactly one stage (escalated_repeat mapped to run), an addition beyond the issue's two independent enums, enforced in validate_payload, build_validation_failure_payload and classify_validation_owner.
  WHY: Valid-looking stage/reason pairs raise ValueError and the CLI exits 2, creating an undocumented contract for later phases.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:172-1520 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: _VALIDATION_HEX_RUN_RE (\b[0-9a-fA-F]{7,64}\b) is broader than the repo's 40-hex convention and rewrites ordinary hex-letter words to <sha>.
  WHY: Distinct failures can collapse to the same signature and fingerprint.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:1654-1684 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: _validation_fix_issues filters non-dict entries before enumerate, so index-<n> refers to the filtered list rather than the diagnosis array.
  WHY: A non-object first element shifts indices and the consumer maps project_fix_ids onto the wrong diagnosis entry.
